claimText:
Refine the active `ela30-1-modern-drama` frame with Film Room dropdown selection, top-bar lesson progress, and sidebar-local collapse control.

Goal:
- Keep the existing ELA 30-1 / Streetcar frame and dedicated Film Room route.
- Replace the Film Room playlist button list with a labeled dropdown selector.
- Show a separate Now Loaded panel with selected video title, source lesson, count, and Open Source action.
- Add a stylized top-bar course progress bar linked to lessons marked complete.
- Move the sidebar collapse button out of the fixed top bar and into the sidebar header.
- Regenerate the `ela30-1-modern-drama` workspace/meta output from the newer ELA 30-1 Brightspace export.

Acceptance boundary:
- Edit the ELA generator, focused generator test, and regenerated `ela30-1-modern-drama` project files only.
- Do not wire in other ELA units right now.
- Do not hand-edit raw Brightspace source files except through regeneration.

STAX acknowledgement:

Objective:
Refine the active `ela30-1-modern-drama` frame with Film Room dropdown selection, top-bar lesson progress, and sidebar-local collapse control.

- `.stax/codex-report.md`
- `.stax/task.md`

- `scripts/lib/ela-modern-drama.ts`
- `scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts`

Tests added:
- Updated the Film Room regression to require a labeled `<select>` playlist, Now Loaded panel, source count text, no playlist buttons, and lesson-title fallback for generic embedded video titles.
- Added a regression proving the fixed top bar contains lesson progress UI wired to completion state, and the sidebar collapse button lives in the sidebar rather than the header.

Commands run:
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` - exit 1 first, expected red failure because the old Film Room had no dropdown.
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` - exit 1 second, expected red failure for generic video title fallback.
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` - exit 1 third, expected red failure for missing top progress/sidebar placement.
- `npx tsx --test scripts/tests/ela-modern-drama-frame.test.ts` - exit 0 after implementation.
- `npx tsx scripts/build-ela-modern-drama.ts --zip "C:\Users\dean.guedo\Downloads\D2LExport_6670_CBE System ELA 30-1 (Winter 2020)_20266815.zip" --slug ela30-1-modern-drama --force` - exit 0.
- Generated HTML structural checks for Film Room dropdown and top progress/sidebar placement - exit 0.
- `npm run verify -- --project ela30-1-modern-drama --mode workspace` - exit 0.
- `npm run typecheck` - exit 0.
- `npm run build:studio` - exit 0.
- Playwright local preview Film Room dropdown check - exit 0.
- Playwright local preview top progress/sidebar/mobile check - exit 0.

Command output summary with exit codes:
- Focused tests now pass: 7 tests, 0 failures.
- Generator rebuilt `ela30-1-modern-drama` with 25 Streetcar lessons.
- Structural checks confirmed Film Room has 1 select, 5 options, 5 video panels, 5 Now Loaded panels, no playlist buttons, and source lesson labels.
- Structural checks confirmed the top header has progress fill/count/percent, the header has no sidebar toggle, and the sidebar has the collapse toggle.
- Project verifier passed metadata policy and reported no missing local assets, no missing workspace embeds, and no missing course-shell resources. It reported expected external dependency warnings for Tailwind CDN and Google fonts/icons.
- Typecheck passed with `tsc --noEmit`.
- Studio production build passed.
- Playwright confirmed dropdown selection switches to Lesson 11, updates the visible iframe/metadata/count, and keeps one video panel visible.
- Playwright confirmed top progress starts at 0%, changes to 4% after one of 25 lessons is marked complete, updates fill width and ARIA value, and has no mobile horizontal overflow.
- Playwright confirmed the sidebar toggle collapses from the sidebar header.

What is verified:
- Film Room uses a labeled dropdown selector instead of playlist buttons.
- The dropdown has 5 video options using meaningful source lesson titles.
- The Now Loaded panel changes with the selected video.
- The fixed top bar includes a styled lesson progress bar, count, and percent.
- The progress bar is linked to lesson completion state.
- The sidebar collapse control is in the sidebar header, not in the fixed top bar.
- Mobile layout has no horizontal overflow with the taller top bar.

What is weak/provisional:
- STAX visual collection and observer preflight have not been rerun yet after the progress/sidebar change.
- Embedded YouTube videos remain network-dependent.
- Source iframe titles are generic, so the generator intentionally substitutes the source lesson title.

What is unverified:
- No Brightspace import/export package was produced in this pass.
- No project E2E contract exists for this slug, so verification used focused tests plus direct Playwright browser route checks.
- No gradebook persistence exists; lesson completion remains local preview state.

Risks:
- Brightspace may handle YouTube iframes differently than the local preview server.
- Future ELA unit swaps should preserve the dropdown catalog pattern, source-title fallback, and progress wiring.
- Forced rebuilds update generated timestamps in metadata.

One next action:
Run STAX visual collection and observer preflight, then commit and push the scoped UI refinement.
